label: RE
definition: 重述压力、挫折、羞愧或不堪重负等主观体验。
representative_evidence: F22558/s001: Wow okay so it sounds like you're feeling pretty confident after our discussion || F26968/s002: okay so right now you have so much going on that you're just feeling totally overwhelmed you don't even know where to start
boundary_note: 当前话语可显示情绪概括，但无法确认是否准确回应前文。

label: RE
definition: 通过确认式或开放式追问促使对方说明计划、原因或立场。
representative_evidence: F29759/s007: So that means you want to quit now right || F15504/s005: So, you're gonna quit then?
boundary_note: 卡片内部混合确认、提问和反映，不宜进一步细分。

label: REC
definition: 概括情绪状态、困境或重要经历并表达理解。
representative_evidence: F22558/s001: Wow okay so it sounds like you're feeling pretty confident after our discussion || F16256/s003: and when you say it was scary I hear you saying on some level was scary for you and your your safety but it also sounds like it was scary because all these other variables or elements were put in motion that were disruptive || F26968/s002: okay so right now you have so much going on that you're just feeling totally overwhelmed you don't even know where to start
boundary_note: 缺少前文，准确性和复杂程度均待人工核对。

label: QUC
definition: 要求在数值量表上报告重要性、信心、准备度或其他主观状态。
representative_evidence: F27857/s001: okay so how confident are you that you can make these changes on a scale of one to ten one being not confident at all and ten being the most confident you've ever felt || F7037/s001: great I'm in Romania to get a break from the sugar I sort of on a scale of 1 to 10 with 10 being the most how motivated do you feel you are to make this change || F664/s004: so on a scale of zero to 100 how important do you think it is for you to make this change
boundary_note: 量表形式高度稳定，但仍属于问句实现与评估功能的结合。

label: QUC
definition: 征求讨论许可、询问方案接受度或让对方在选项间表达立场。
representative_evidence: F18646/s001: it's kind of the same old routine um I wonder if it would be okay if we could talk about some of the options that are out there for folks that have some mild depression || F4998/s001: so is this an inconvenience that you can move past or is this a major life event that does change things || F8089/s005: so does either of those sound like they might work for you
boundary_note: 卡片内部也包含一般探索问题。

label: GI
definition: 解释药物用途、剂量、频率、副作用或服用要求。
representative_evidence: F8166/s008: okay so I wrote a prescription for an antibiotic for Aidan that should help with the ear infection || F16131/s001: yeah I'm the pharmacist on duty citalopram okay it's an antidepressant and it comes in   and  milligram strength it's excreted in the urine and it has a half-life of about  hours for side effects there are sexual side effects heart side effects and stomachs side effects || F19483/s004: Okay well smoking really is really bad for you, you know it causes things like lung cancer, emphysema, heart disease.
boundary_note: 部分卡片同时包含建议和风险信息。

label: SU
definition: 表达理解、承认困难或确认对方处境。
representative_evidence: F24760/s001: I completely understand your you have a busy lifestyle || F29825/s001: sure it's quite understandable to be nervous coming in to talk to it like this || F4756/s004: and I do get where you're coming from
boundary_note: I understand 等模板可能只体现话语形式，真实共情效果仍需语境。

label: SU
representation_component: 提供帮助与支持可用性
definition: 明确表达愿意帮助或询问对方需要何种帮助。
representative_evidence: F9720/s005: listen I really want to help you || F4512/s005: yeah I really want to help you || F16190/s001: I'm here to help
boundary_note: help 词汇高度重复，需把行为功能与词汇模板同时报告。

label: AF
representation_component: 行动、目标与个人优势肯定
representation_component_en: affirmation of actions, goals, and strengths
definition: 正向评价对方的行动、计划、努力或个人优势。
representative_evidence: F30870/s004: that's a great goal to have for yourself || F6676/s003: I'm glad you called. || F28469/s002: I am so proud of you that is awesome Taylor think I am just that couldn't be happier and wait till we tell the group
boundary_note: 正向词汇可能是表层线索，不能仅凭形容词认定完整行为功能。

label: AF
definition: 在重述对方计划或状态时加入鼓励和正向强化。
representative_evidence: F7143/s001: sounds like you're really motivated and you're doing some research and kind of staying on top of it that's you know trying || F25532/s001: that sounds like a great idea
boundary_note: 部分证据更接近一般反映或固定 sounds like 模板。

label: AF
definition: 通过感谢、赞赏参与或礼貌收尾维持互动关系。
representative_evidence: F9869/s003: Thank you so much for calling me back, I sure appreciate it || F24206/s001: so thank you so thank you for being here and congratulations again for taking that first step || F11511/s002: and this has been very useful I appreciate you
boundary_note: 感谢是社会互动功能，不应与对个人优势的肯定合并。

label: RE
definition: 以 it/it's/that is 等结构组织评价、判断或状态描述。
representative_evidence: F15068/s003: yeah and it got the feeling that it's something that you want to think about that this is a really big decision and it's not one that you're gonna make in a hurry || F111/s005: So it sounds that you have been dealing with this for a while? || F30798/s001: It does sound like something pretty significant happened that sort of  Freaked everybody out.
boundary_note: 该结构覆盖面广，可能是通用英语句法而非标签特异机制。

label: QU
definition: 使用 do you 及相近助动词前置结构发问。
representative_evidence: F12340/s001: do you think that this will be helpful I'm black Franny || F16969/s030: do you drink alcohol
boundary_note: 主要是句法形式证据。

label: QUC
definition: 使用 how long/how much 等形式询问时长或数量。
representative_evidence: F29947/s004: okay and how long have you been smoking? || F8861/s001: and I'm curious as to how much time did you spend walking your dog in nature
boundary_note: 编码的是量化问句实现，不是独立行为机制。

label: QUC
definition: 重复出现量表、数值端点和评分提示结构。
representative_evidence: F18714/s002: could you say on a scale of zero to ten ten being really ready zero being not ready at all how ready would you be to do some counselling || F32565/s004: so let me ask you on a scale of zero to ten zero being not confident at all and ten being 100% confident how confident are you that you will be able to stay consistent with this new exercise regime || F2416/s002: and on a scale from zero to 100 100 how confident are you in making this change
boundary_note: 与行为层的结构化自评相呼应，但此处证据层是表层模板。

label: QUC
definition: 多种问句与陈述混合，无法稳定归为单一形式。
representative_evidence: F9827/s001: okay so is there anything else that you like about it || F736/s013: did you have a sense when you came in
boundary_note: 不据此判断 QUC 功能边界。

label: GI
definition: 重复出现 actually、yeah、it is 等过渡和确认标记。
representative_evidence: F2055/s001: um now I was taking a look at your medication profile earlier and it looks like you're on two different strengths of lipitor so that obviously it can't be right || F23723/s003: Actually, if you look up here... the roof of your mouth, I'm noticing a lot of irritation that's really consistent with tobacco use || F5828/s001: no but you know I was recording the show that I watch and it was on there and so I've just gone back and watched it you know again and again my wife I've heard it a couple other times on the news hey everybody yeah
boundary_note: F5828 含非医疗样例，说明该模式更可能是通用话语结构。

label: GI
definition: 围绕药物名称、处方、剂量、治疗和咨询场景。
representative_evidence: F16345/s001: he's right this medicine is designed to help lower your cholesterol and that means that it will help lower your risk of having a heart attack or a stroke || F8294/s001: yeah I'm the pharmacist on duty citalopram okay it's an antidepressant and it comes in   and  milligram strength it's excreted in the urine and it has a half-life of about  hours for side effects there are sexual side effects heart side effects and stomachs side effects || F21634/s003: okay well you're going to take one tablet of cholesteryl sent in twenty one time a day by mouth and you can take that with or without food
boundary_note: 主题集中不等于模型表征了信息给予功能。

label: GI
representation_component_en: health risk and clinical metrics topic
definition: 围绕疾病风险、血压、胆固醇、数量指标和健康后果。
representative_evidence: F26879/s003: because smoking is a major risk factor for DVT even if you even if we treat you now if you don't quit smoking I'm afraid the blood clots will return again || F26236/s001: okay okay so this medication is for your cholesterol || F16515/s001: did you know that a glass of orange juice has almost as many calories as a can of cola
boundary_note: 可能同时包含建议、事实和量化语言。

label: GI
definition: 围绕饮食、体重、锻炼和日常健康行为。
representative_evidence: F9893/s004: there are there's a couple out there one called protein power and but a lot of my patients have had a lot of luck with South Beach diet || F18490/s001: overall, obesity can lead to many chronic conditions || F30517/s001: John is very important that you recognize that some fruits but especially fruit juice can contain a huge amount of calories
boundary_note: 主题特征不能直接解释互动功能。

label: GI
definition: 多种健康行为和医疗内容混合出现。
representative_evidence: F17827/s007: your ac it measures the amount of sugar that's been on your hemoglobin in the last three months to determine how well you've been controlling your blood sugar || F17685/s001: most people who smoke do it because they as does something good for them
boundary_note: 主题范围较宽，作为剩余主题成分保留。

label: SU
definition: 使用 I、I've、I can、I would 等第一人称结构表达立场或支持。
representative_evidence: F19359/s001: I'm guessing you've learned a lot of lessons || F8760/s003: I understand you've come here today to the agency because you have a recent arrest || F16045/s001: I have a lot of thoughts about it a lot of memories about it I think I've just kind of got to work through them you know we had this really sad but I can't let it roll my life you said it
boundary_note: 第一人称结构可承载多种功能。

label: SU
definition: 使用 this/that + 系词或形容词形成评价性陈述。
representative_evidence: F22730/s001: This is the first time that you've had something that really happened, this incident that happened where he pushed you really, prompted you to, to take some steps || F24856/s010: and that's great
boundary_note: 结构证据不能单独确认支持行为。

label: SU
definition: 表达困难、压力、艰难或不愉快体验。
representative_evidence: F16736/s001: I mean realistically not everyone is a success story and we see its relapse it's a part of recovery but but for most cases though that difficult cases that do a good job and make that transformation when does that usually occur || F11872/s001: so you've tried some diets before and they haven't worked out and since you're a single mom with kids is it's been hard for you to cook meals or do grocery shopping?
boundary_note: 情感内容可能支持共情，但本身不是共情行为。

label: SU
definition: 多种咨询、支持或一般会谈功能混合，无法稳定分离。
representative_evidence: F5366/s001: that's particularly hard when those anniversaries come around for the passings of our parents that's a that's a very difficult time I || F2995/s002: this is a big stuff for you I know I'm it's hard to make a step like this
boundary_note: 保留为不清晰成分，不推断统一支持机制。

label: AF
definition: 重复出现 thank you、thanks for coming 和 thank you for + 动名词等结构。
representative_evidence: F17793/s003: thanks so much for coming in today || F28724/s001: hi Heather thanks for coming in || F2434/s001: Thanks for comming today
boundary_note: 可能是固定礼貌模板，需与行为层感谢功能并列报告。

label: AF
representation_component: 评价性句式（以正向为主）
definition: 使用 that's/that is/good/great 等系词和形容词表达正向或负向评价，其中正向用法占主导。
representative_evidence: F32764/s006: Wow yeah wow that is awesome || F24856/s010: and that's great || F16965/s001: does that capture for you some of the good things or things that are keeping you smoking
boundary_note: F32764/F24856 也覆盖 upsetting、hard 等负向评价，不能视为纯正向行为。

label: AF
definition: 稳定出现 good、great、awesome 等正向评价和赞扬内容。
representative_evidence: F23464/s002: that's good to hear || F22475/s010: it's good to see you again || F29908/s001: Wow, nice.
boundary_note: 高一致性可能来自词汇方向，仍需与行为肯定区分。
